cards.name: MCP Gateway
cards.hint: Add/remove tools from the dashboard. Connect at http://localhost:8811/mcp — see services/mcp-gateway/README.md
cards.notes: The gateway answers a bare GET to /mcp with a 4xx (it expects POST/SSE with an Mcp-Session-Id) — check_4xx_ok tells the strict dependency probe that a <500 there still means up.
